title: Resend testimonial drift
description: A centred lit title and lead over an endless row of graphite quote cards with hairlines that drift slowly to the left and pause while hovered; each card holds a grey quote, a pair of overlapping avatars and a name with role, and fades into the black page at its bottom.
notes: CSS loop (180s per lap like the original, scaled to the number of cards); off under reduced motion, where the row scrolls by hand
